Bihar MLA's Daughter's Wedding Features Lavish Preparations

Preparations for the wedding of Bihar MLA Anant Singh's daughter, scheduled for November 25 in Ladma village, Patna, include a grand feast, horse races, and a Thar SUV. Reports mention 50 lakh gulab jamuns as part of the culinary arrangements.
